stock.description: Century Plaza Hotel Group, previously known as Greatwalle Inc., functions as an investment holding company primarily focused on security guarding and property management. The company's operations are divided into two main divisions. Its Security Guarding and Property Management segment offers comprehensive security and property management services. Separately, the Asset Management segment provides specialized business consulting and asset management solutions.
